sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the bracelet on your non-dominant hand (left hand for most people) to receive the crystal energy naturally.

• Best day to wear the Nazar Sutra Bracelet is Saturday morning.

• Cleanse & set your intention by holding the bracelet in your hand, taking a few calm breaths, and focusing on what you want the bracelet to support.

• To recharge, place the bracelet on the Selenite Recharging Plate and leave it for a few hours or overnight.

• Handle with care and avoid water, perfumes, or harsh chemicals to maintain the crystals’ natural beauty.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 A Silent Shield You Carry Every Day!

Minimal in design yet powerful in purpose, the Nazar Sutra Bracelet is ideal for daily wear—whether at work, during travel, or in everyday life—whenever you want to feel calm, guarded, and aligned.

At its center of this bracelet rests the Hamsa (Hamsai) charm, a timeless symbol of protection believed to block the evil eye, invite positivity, and offer spiritual safeguarding. Recognized across cultures, it forms the protective center of the bracelet, gently guarding your energy.

Encircling the charm is a thoughtfully balanced crystal sequence, each chosen for its unique strength:

-> Tiger Eye crystals represent courage, confidence, and bold action.

-> Obsidian acts as a powerful energy shield, absorbing negativity and emotional stress.

-> Clear Quartz balances and amplifies the energies of all surrounding crystals.

-> Tourmaline is known for grounding energy and protecting against negative vibrations.

________________________________________________________________________________________________

Note: As crystals are natural, slight variations in color and texture may occur.

Disclaimer: The Nazar Sutra Bracelet is designed to support protection, grounding, and positive energy through intention and belief. Results may vary from person to person depending on mindset, actions, and personal effort. This product is not meant to replace practical decision-making and consistent efforts.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. What is the Nazar Sutra Bracelet used for?

It is designed to protect against nazar (evil eye), negative energy, and unwanted attention while keeping your energy balanced.

2. What does the Hamsa (Hamsai) charm symbolize?

The Hamsa charm is believed to block negative energies, offer spiritual protection, and attract positivity and peace.

3. Which crystals are used in this bracelet?

The bracelet includes Tiger Eye, Obsidian, Clear Quartz, and Tourmaline, arranged in a balanced crystal flow.

4. What role does Obsidian play in this bracelet?

Obsidian absorbs negative energy and helps protect against emotional stress and negativity.

5. How does Clear Quartz help?

Clear Quartz balances energy and enhances the effect of all other crystals in the bracelet.

6. Is this bracelet suitable for daily wear?

Yes, it is designed for everyday use and can be worn to work, travel, or regular outings.

7. Can this bracelet be gifted?

Absolutely. It makes a thoughtful gift for someone who needs protection, strength, or positive energy.

8. How do I cleanse the bracelet energetically?

You can place it on a Selenite charging plate, leave it under moonlight, or gently cleanse it with incense.
